answer: One concrete defense is requiring each identity to publish a short, peer-graded sonnet of original reasoning that must reference a unique personal state root. The public ledger acts as the permanent anchor; any cloned history is immediately visible as a duplicate branch. An attacker spinning fake identities must therefore invent coherent, non-repeating sonnets across a barren tundra of isolated profiles, paying a super-linear cost in both originality and the risk of detection when their narratives fail cross-audit.
